# figma-code-sync

> Keep a Figma library and a codebase one design: generated tokens, a name-matched component map, a snapshot of the published Library with per-component fingerprints, and drift gates for git hooks and CI. Zero-dependency Node CLI plus a Claude Code plugin.

Install: `npm i -D github:jasonchandesign/figma-code-sync#v0.1.0`, then `npx figma-code-sync init` (guided; `--yes` and flags for non-interactive use).
Machine-readable state: `npx figma-code-sync status --json` → `{ state: code-first|unseeded|design-first|in-step|diverged|in-sync, next, errors[], warnings[] }`.

## Docs

- [Agent setup protocol](AGENTS.md): the exact commands and checks to set a project up, and what to do in each state
- [README](README.md): what it is, how it works, quick start, every command and its exit codes

- [The gates](docs/gates.md): every rejection each gate produces, and why it is a rule
- [Reference](docs/reference.md): figma-sync.config.js, component-map.json and figma-components.json field by field
- [Plugin and programmatic API](docs/plugin.md): the design-audit and figma-workflow skills, the build kit's rules, check.run() / tokens.check() from a test runner
- [Adapters](docs/adapters.md): css-tailwind4 (extract), swift (emit), writing your own
- [Caveats](docs/caveats.md): what Figma cannot show, what this package does not check, Plugin API quirks
- [Migrating](docs/migrating.md): from the original Python scripts
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md)
- [Workflow contract template](templates/WORKFLOW.md): the per-project decisions a team records
- [figma-workflow skill](plugin/skills/figma-workflow/SKILL.md): building the Library and screens through Figma's plugin API; [the build kit](plugin/skills/figma-workflow/references/kit.js)
- [design-audit skill](plugin/skills/design-audit/SKILL.md): comparing live Figma variable values and raw values with the tokens

## Constraints

- Works on Figma Professional: no Code Connect, no Variables REST API; variable values are audited through the Figma MCP.
- Only the published Library is gated; the Product file is not.
- Publishing a Library is a human action.
